PREFACE

Research has shown that pupils who do homework perform better in school than
those who do not. However, the amount and the type of homework given must take

into account the child’s developmental level. It is in this recognition that we based the
development of SIGNAL HOLIDAY HOMEWORK.

Assigning homework provides opportunities for the extension and application of

skills taught in class in a new environment (home). This enhances parental
engagement as they guide and supervise the homework.

Homework also fosters independent learning, development of good study habits and
recognition that learning can occur at home.

We highly welcome any suggestions that would further improve our holiday
homework workbooks from our readers.

THE SIGNAL TEAM
